  • Method Details

    • loadCryptoPriceHistory

      @PostConstruct public void loadCryptoPriceHistory()
      Chargement des données du fichier JSON au démarrage.

    • saveCryptoPriceHistory

      @PreDestroy public void saveCryptoPriceHistory()
      Saves the crypto price history data to a file when the application is stopped. The data is saved in JSON format to a file named "crypto_price_history.json" in the "src/main/resources" directory.

    • addCryptoForPriceHistory

      public void addCryptoForPriceHistory(List<CryptoCurrency> cryptoCurrencyList)
      Adds a new entry for each list of cryptocurrencies to the price history table in the database. Only existing cryptocurrencies in the database are added.
      Parameters:
      cryptoCurrencyList - a list of CryptoCurrency objects

    • collectMarketData

      @Scheduled(fixedRate=60000L) public void collectMarketData()
      This method is scheduled to run every 60 seconds and collects market data from the CoinCap API. The collected data is then saved to the database.

    • getCryptoPriceHistoryMap

      public static Map<String,List<CryptoPriceHistory>> getCryptoPriceHistoryMap()
      Returns a map of all the CryptoPriceHistory objects in the database. Each key is the name of a cryptocurrency, and the value is a list of CryptoPriceHistory objects for that currency.
      Returns:
      A map of all the CryptoPriceHistory objects in the database.
